title: Korean Folklore to Fall Asleep To | Gumiho, Fox Sister & Grim Reapers
hook: Lie back, listen to the rain, and let Gumi, a 1,000-year-old nine-tailed fox, tell you four Korean tales until you drift off.

thumb.img: a white nine-tailed fox curled up asleep on the wooden veranda of a traditional Korean hanok at night, gentle rain falling, one paper lantern glowing warm amber, deep blue night, peaceful

intro.img: a quiet room in a traditional Korean hanok at night, a single paper lantern glowing low, rain falling past the open sliding door, soft blue shadows, peaceful
intro.say: Shh. It's late, and the rain has found the roof tiles. You don't need to do anything now. Just get comfortable, and let your eyes grow a little heavy.
It's only me, Gumi. I've been awake for a thousand years, so tonight, let me do the staying awake for you.

intro.img: a sleeping Joseon village under a full moon, thatched roofs, mist drifting along dark mountains, fireflies over the rice paddies, calm
intro.say: I'll tell you four old stories, slowly, one after another. You don't have to remember any of them. If you fall asleep halfway through, the stories will wait for you.

link.img: a narrow mountain path through pine trees at dusk in old Korea, a lone lantern hanging from a branch, soft fog, calm and quiet
link.say: The first story is about my own kind. A boy, a long road over the mountain, and a girl with a red ribbon who was always waiting beside the path.

link.img: a large traditional Korean farmhouse at night, warm light in one paper window, a wooden barn beside it, quiet fields under the stars, calm
link.say: Breathe in slowly. And out. The next story comes from a big house with a quiet barn, and a family who wished very hard for a daughter.

link.img: a cozy room with a warm ondol floor in an old Korean house at night, a folded sleeping mat, a small electric fan, moonlight through paper doors, peaceful
link.say: Now something gentler. Not one tale this time, but a handful of small old rules that Korean grandmothers still whisper. Just listen, and let them float by.

tales.chapter: The Real Legends in KPop Demon Hunters

link.img: a quiet Korean village lane at midnight, paper lanterns, far down the lane the silhouette of a tall figure in a wide black hat, soft mist, calm and mysterious
link.say: One more, and then you can let the rain take over. This last story is about the quiet men in black hats who come at the very end of a long life, and the old ways Korean families greeted them.

outro.say: That's all the stories for tonight. You did very well, dear human. You listened all the way to the end, or maybe you didn't, and that's fine too.

outro.img: rain falling softly on the tiled roof and wooden veranda of a quiet hanok at night, a single lantern, puddles reflecting warm light, deep blue darkness, peaceful, no people
outro.say: I'll leave the rain on for a while. Sleep well, dear human. I'll keep watch until morning.
